Maharashtra TET Exam Postponed Amid Suspected Paper Leak Investigation

The Maharashtra Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) has been postponed due to a suspected question paper leak, leading to an investigation into an alleged inter-state racket. Authorities are considering invoking the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA) against those involved. The incident has prompted discussions about conducting future government examinations online and has led to disruptions in the state legislature.
